description: Taboola base pixel loader on cdn.taboola.com/libtrc/unip, whose numeric account ID rides in the path.

params.name: account_id
params.description: It is the numeric Taboola Account ID. Taboola documents the loader as `cdn.taboola.com/libtrc/unip/<account_id>/tfa.js`.
params.fix_hint: Replace `<account_id>` with the numeric Account ID from Realize Tracking.
